title: MacDeviceApprovalService
responsibility: Binds Mac device admission and approval actions to the current encrypted Hub login, keeping keys in the native helper.

inputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalService.constructor.binary
inputs.description: Absolute path to the bundled macOS helper.

inputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalService.status.credential
inputs.description: Current main-process credential for the exact Hub and Google subject.

inputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalService.status.actor
inputs.description: The Google actor already verified by the Hub.

inputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalService.action.action
inputs.description: One validated list, review, approve or deny request for the admitted device.

outputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalService.status
outputs.description: Public login stage and verified actor or comparison code where appropriate.

outputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalService.action
outputs.description: Approval inbox display or decision state. No session or key material is returned.

outputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalService.close
outputs.description: Invalidates queued work and ends the current helper without signing out the Hub account.

errors.name: MacDeviceApprovalError
errors.description: A public, bounded failure code reports a refusal or an unavailable helper without including request contents.
